name: Ruya Community Islamic Bank
founded: Launch announced 29 Feb 2024 as a digital-native Islamic community bank licensed by the CBUAE as a 'specialised bank'; head office and first community centre in Marsa, Ajman. Incorporation date and CBUAE licence date/number not found.
ownership_summary: Private LLC. In an interview of 4 Apr 2024 the CEO said the bank has a capital base of 'over Dh300 million' and that its promoters are UAE-based 'holding companies'; no shareholder is named in any source found, and no percentages are published (checked 12 Oct 2026). Chairman and Vice Chairman were named at the Feb 2024 launch.

shareholders.holder: Undisclosed UAE-based 'holding companies' (described as the promoters by the CEO; no names or percentages published)

government_link: Not found after research. No government or sovereign shareholder is disclosed. Ajman government bodies (Department of Economic Development, Free Zones Authority, Thara Centre) appear only as commercial/MoU partners in search results, not as owners (S21, S22). Checked 2026-10-12.
group_structure: Single licensed entity (Ruya Community Islamic Bank LLC per the website footer). No parent, subsidiary or affiliated investment company found. The CBUAE's Arabic list of Islamic banks reportedly shows it as a local (domestic) Islamic bank, alongside Ajman Bank, Al Hilal Bank, DIB and Emirates Islamic (seen in search results only; the page returned 403) (S17). No subsidiaries or affiliates found.
footprint: UAE only. Head office and 'Ruya Community Center' at Building No. 4, Marsa Ajman Mall, Ajman (S2); digital-first with an app on the Apple App Store and Google Play (S1). A community centre in Abu Dhabi was reported as planned (search summary only, not verified). Checked 2026-10-12.
customer_segments: Retail individuals including families and a Kids savings account, young adults new to banking, and small and family businesses; the CEO said in Apr 2024 it was not mainly targeting SMEs as many digital-only banks do (S9). No affluent, priority or private-banking tier found.
business_lines: Personal banking: current account (UAE PASS onboarding, no minimums, free debit card and cheque book), savings account with profit-sharing, Kids savings account, Standard and Max debit cards, Shariah-compliant personal finance, Wakala Investment Deposit and Mudaraba Term Deposit, remittances to eight countries and bill payments (S3). Business banking: current account (AED 79 monthly subscription), Wakala deposit, WPS payroll and payment solutions (S4). Mastercard cashback credit card launched Apr 2026 (S14). In-app virtual-asset trading including Bitcoin launched Apr 2025 with Fuze (S11). Banking-as-a-Service infrastructure for fintech partners was described by the CEO in Dec 2025 (S13).

capabilities.wealth_summary: ruya is a small, digital-first Islamic community bank in Ajman aimed at mass-market retail and small businesses, with no affluent or private-banking tier found. Its published investment products on ruyabank.ae are a Wakala Investment Deposit and a Mudaraba Term Deposit (personal) and a Wakala deposit (business). On 24 Apr 2025 it launched in-app buying and selling of virtual assets including Bitcoin with Fuze, which it describes as a world first for an Islamic bank (company claim). In Dec 2025 the CEO described a 'Retail Islamic Wealth platform' giving access to Shariah-screened portfolios across stocks, ETFs, gold, sukuk and digital assets, and said Islamic banks 'must partner the ecosystem, not compete with it'; the stock, ETF, gold and sukuk offering is not described on the bank's product pages, so its live status is unverified. A Mastercard cashback credit card launched in Apr 2026. No AUM, client-asset or financial figures are published.

The personal banking page (S3, checked 12 Oct 2026) lists only Wakala and Mudaraba deposits and no virtual assets, stocks, ETFs, gold or sukuk; the FAQ lists a Bitcoin question (S5).

discrepancies.resolution: Used the website footer name as the legal name.

discrepancies.resolution: Treated as operating since 2024; the waiting-list statement is pre-launch and superseded.
